paper.title: UniTopRank: a scalable and language-independent method for toponym resolution
paper.journal: International Journal of Geographical Information Science
paper.licence_as_found: CC BY 4.0 (Crossref licence URL for the article; not a licence for the data)
paper.dataset_table: unverified. The publisher page returned a bot challenge (HTTP 403), so the paper's dataset table was not read.

toporesolve.licence_note: No licence field in the repository metadata and no licence file at the root (the root holds README.md, data and models). The README states no licence.
toporesolve.gold_granularity: One entity per record, with coordinates and context sentences. The gold has no character offsets into the text.
toporesolve.gpe_geometry_note: The README scores GPE by whether the prediction falls inside the state or country polygon, not by distance. The gold file holds a point, not a polygon, so the polygon comes from outside the gold.
